method: Web search and fetch on Oct 14, 2026. ATTOM publishes only the five longest and five shortest state timelines per quarter, so typicalDaysToComplete is filled for 14 places from ATTOM Q2 2026, Q3 2025 and Q2 2025 releases and left null elsewhere. National ATTOM average: 563 days (Q2 2026), 608 days (Q3 2025). Process type, notice periods and redemption are the researcher's recall of each state's statute, cross-checked against the Bills.com state table (updated 2015, partly outdated) and American Default's 2026 judicial/nonjudicial list; official legislature pages, Nolo and Justia could not be fetched (403/404). No place is rated high because no statute text was read this pass. Treat every value as an estimate until the statute is read; the 'estimatedFields' list names those that are weakest or null.

federal.citation: 12 CFR 1024.41(f)(1) (Regulation X): a servicer may not make the first notice or filing for foreclosure until the loan is more than 120 days delinquent

fields.process: nonjudicial, judicial or both: the route most residential foreclosures use; null if none found
fields.noticeOfDefaultDays: days the borrower has after a statutory notice of default or intent to foreclose before sale or filing can proceed; null if the statute sets none
fields.saleNoticeDays: days of published or mailed notice before the sale
fields.typicalDaysToComplete: ATTOM average days from first public notice to completed foreclosure for the quarter named in typicalDaysSource
fields.redemptionDaysAfterSale: statutory redemption days after sale; 0 if none
fields.estimatedFields: fields not read from statute or official source, or null

US-AL.statute: Ala. Code 35-10-1 et seq. (sale publication 3 consecutive weeks, 35-10-13); 35-10-120 (redemption)
US-AL.note: Redemption is one year generally; a shorter homestead period may apply; sources conflict. Secondary sources (Bills.com 2015 table, ATTOM press release); statute recalled, not read from the official site.

US-AK.note: Judicial sales carry a 12-month redemption; nonjudicial none. Secondary sources (Bills.com 2015 table, ATTOM press release); statute recalled, not read from the official site.
